fieldValues.title: Classed: choice, ruling or escalation
fieldValues.moved_by: the builder (srs-decisions `made[].class`; Mode and Door lines)
fieldValues.theory: Choice: the builder decides, never ratified. Ruling: inside the mandate, in the group's log. Escalation: outside it, a framed ask to the parent. Mode (clear, complicated, complex, chaotic) and door (1, 2, 3) set who merges.
gaps: `made` choices are never promoted to records; doors are not enforced (srs#589); 33 of 92 decisions have no kind and the kinds themselves are in question.
fieldValues.evidence: clerk/docs/pr-decisions.md; decision-compass.md; decision-flow survey 2026-10-24 (srs CLI and gh api counts, recorded on clerk#126)
